name: Lycanmoon
look: a towering brown werewolf brawler with a grinning snout, shaggy yellow hair, a leaf-marked chest, spiky yellow shoulder pads, red-brown fists, a green leafy loincloth, a flame-like tail and a vine lasso
entry: It ropes its opponents with a vine lasso and pulls them into the reach of its fists. Under a full moon it howls so loudly that every Wigwoof for miles answers.
how: Evolve Wolfevel at level 36. It learns Drain Punch when it evolves.
